title: Microbial Growth: Population Characteristics and Measurement
method: Whitespace-delimited visible teaching paragraph text in 14 theory sections, excluding worked-example labels, headings, figures, captions, tables, practice, references and UI. Article includes headings, labels, captions, tables, practice and references, excluding SVG contents and buttons.
comparator: 2.D.10 QA: 7,560 narrative words; 2.D.08 QA: 8,439; 2.A.02 QA: 11,569. Current chapter has 14 balanced theory sections and 31 labeled numerical/quantitative reasoning cases; the additional depth is devoted to measurement assumptions and interpretation rather than unrelated growth-phase/kinetic or bioreactor topics.
scientific_checks: Official merged NET Unit 2.E page 3, separate CSIR NET page 2 and archived MP SET 2024 page 2 visually inspected. Reviewed population/biomass identity, independent cell vs CFU, viability/culturability/VBNC, recovery controls, sampling, chamber volume, decimal and unequal dilution, volume correction, pooling, countability, ideal Poisson uncertainty and zero detection, OD physics and conditional calibration, dry mass and paired interpretation. OpenStax, ATCC, FDA, manufacturer geometry, Oliver, Kell, Staley/Konopka and Stevenson references used. First examiner-style review expanded evidence and corrected reference/measurement conditions; second examiner-style self-review audited numerical cases, figures and graph questions. Fifty independently recomputed numerical checks passed. Original illustrative data, diagrams and questions. No clinical or bioreactor protocol detail.
limitations: Two editorial self-review passes by the same assistant, not an independent human reviewer. Static source/geometry QA; interactive browser/device, independent visual rendering and assistive technology testing not performed. MP SET source is an archived copy of 2024 syllabus rather than a current original MPPSC-hosted document. Live Pages verification must be separate.
